findings.message: Three reviewed catalogs lack the candidate callback source; latest scope reserves it absent. No actual init or complete transitive graph can be audited.

Existing helpers expose shared schema cache, legacy header fallthrough, DB-aware identity helpers and panic-capable hashing; selectively reusing them requires actual call graph proof and strict wrappers.
Pinned FunctionImpl/registerFunction cannot express INNOCUOUS. A default-off dependency capability patch is distinct from permission to enable it for missing callback implementations.

not_inferred: No finding claims actual missing callbacks are impure.
No static helper review is a SQL test.
No finite repeatability test can establish absence of all external side effects.
historical_failure_policy: Prior original payload copied byte-for-byte. Native NULL preserved. No counter writes or repeated old failing inputs.
